name: DS Cluster D11: Corporate Events (Intraday — ffill for sparse earnings)
description: Tests: earnings on intraday, ffill carries last EPS through all bars. After-hours events may land on 0 RTH bars.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D11 INTRADAY: Earnings + ffill
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === EARNINGS (sparse — ffill for intraday) ===
earn = earnings()()
last_eps = ffill(earn.actual_eps)
last_surprise = ffill(earn.eps_surprise_percent)

# === DIVIDENDS (sparse — ffill) ===
div = dividends(dividend_type=DividendType.CD)()
last_div = ffill(div.cash_amount)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Last Known EPS (ffill'd on intraday)",
    category="Events",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="EPS", color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=last_eps)

xy_lines(
    title="Last Known Dividend (ffill'd on intraday)",
    category="Events",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Dividend", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=last_div)
